facts.business: Sadbhav Engineering Limited is an Indian infrastructure construction company engaged in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of roads, highways, irrigation, and mining projects.

auditor.name: M/s. Manubhai & Shah LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on standalone financial statements due to inability to corroborate recoverability of Rs 20,178.30 lakhs from step-down subsidiary Rohtak Panipat Tollway Private Limited, Rs 54,864.44 lakhs investment and Rs 32,938.49 lakhs loan to Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Limited, and Rs 35,019.32 lakhs contract assets from closed/suspended projects. Emphasis of matter on vendor legal proceedings and going concern.

key_risks: Recoverability of loans, trade receivables, and investments in subsidiaries with eroded net worth
Uncertainty in recovery of contract assets from closed/suspended projects under arbitration/litigation
Debt restructuring implementation risk and default history with lenders
Ongoing insolvency proceedings by operational and financial creditors
Dependence on successful execution of Master Restructuring Agreement and NCD issuance
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include unsecured loans from a director/promoter (Rs 56.92 lakhs) and a company where directors are directors (Rs 5,611.29 lakhs). Equity shares of subsidiary Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Limited pledged with banks/financial institutions (13,73,15,340 shares as of FY25-26).
